summary:
Alice and I developed this game on a website for creating games. I wrote a text explaining everything that Alice and I wanted in our game, then I sent this text and the website created the game and the link.

The challenge was simple: create a game about a space mission, so that's what we did. The main characters in the game are our best friends, and the player interacts with them and can choose their own appearance.

The game teaches what it would be like to survive on the Moon for 30 days, and the player must make the most important decisions in the best way possible, having to save water and food and keep the crew members healthy.
details: Our game works like "the right choice" because the game gives options of what you should choose for the best of the mission. The intention of the project is to make the player feel like they are on a real NASA mission. Alice and I used a website to create the game just by telling our idea, and the website created the game with our idea. We made it like the "script" of the game. Our creativity was to make the player feel important in the game, with the main characters: Rafaela (me), Alice, Helena, Rebecca, Sophia, Ester, and Larissa interacting with the player. We imagined that in the game there was a new permanent base on the Moon and the 8 astronauts (including the player) were the first ones to go to the base.
